svg.title: Pac-man eats the last 12 months of contributions
svg.desc: The real GitHub contribution grid for the last 12 months — 2374 contributions over 174 active days, peak day 104 on Jul 4 — with an animated pac-man eating it row by row while four ghosts give chase.
